summary: Amesite Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a press release disclosing a new enterprise customer with an approximately 2,700-patient census deployment of its NurseMagic AI platform. No financial terms, price, premium, or board recommendation are provided. The filing is a routine business development announcement, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer. It is a standard current report on a customer win and operational milestone, with no structural or transactional elements that would classify it as a special situation.
